metadata.question: Was there more snow in the Sierra Nevada mountains on January 1, 2022, than on April 1 and May 4, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS snow cover product (MOD10A1 or MODIS/006/MOD10A1_SNOW_COVER) for consistent snow detection - Three dates: January 1, 2022, April 1, 2022, and May 4, 2022 - Sierra Nevada mountains location: approximately [-121.5, 37.5, -118.5, 40.5] 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS snow product has NDSI_Snow_Cover band (0-100% snow cover) - Should use QA band to filter out cloud-obscured pixels - Calculate total snow cover area or mean snow cover percentage 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: If images exist but snow cover is 0%, that's a valid "B" (no, less snow in January) - C1: If no images found for any date - C2: If after cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - Compare January snow to both April and May - January should have MORE than both for answer "A" ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Sierra Nevada region const sierra = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-121.5, 37.5, -118.5, 40.5]); // 2. Define dates const date1 = '2022-01-01'; const date2 = '2022-04-01'; const date3 = '2022-05-04'; try { // 3. Get MODIS snow cover data const getSnowCover = (date) => { const col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(sierra); return col; }; const col1 = getSnowCover(date1); const col2 = getSnowCover(date2); const col3 = getSnowCover(date3); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); const size3 = await col3.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 1 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Apr 1 Images: ${size2}`); console.log(`May 4 Images: ${size3}`); // Check for empty collections if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0 || size3 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or more dates."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Process snow cover with cloud masking const processSnow = (collection) => { const img = collection.first(); const snow = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const qa = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover_Basic_QA'); // Mask clouds and invalid data (QA: 0=best, 1=good, 2=ok, 3=poor, 4-255=other) const mask = qa.lte(2); return snow.updateMask(mask); }; const snow1 = processSnow(col1); const snow2 = processSnow(col2); const snow3 = processSnow(col3); // 5. Calculate statistics const stats1 = await snow1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: sierra, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await snow2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: sierra, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats3 = await snow3.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: sierra, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean1 = stats1.NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean; const count1 = stats1.NDSI_Snow_Cover_count; const mean2 = stats2.NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean; const count2 = stats2.NDSI_Snow_Cover_count; const mean3 = stats3.NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean; const count3 = stats3.NDSI_Snow_Cover_count; console.log(`Jan 1: Mean=${mean1?.toFixed(2)}%, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Apr 1: Mean=${mean2?.toFixed(2)}%, Pixels=${count2}`); console.log(`May 4: Mean=${mean3?.toFixed(2)}%, Pixels=${count3}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0 || count3 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after cloud masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (mean1 === null || mean1 === undefined || mean2 === null || mean2 === undefined || mean3 === null || mean3 === undefined) { console.log("Calculation returned invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 6. Compare: Was Jan 1 > Apr 1 AND Jan 1 > May 4? if (mean1 > mean2 && mean1 > mean3) { console.log("January had more snow than both April and May."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("January did not have more snow than both dates."); console.log("B"); } } catch (error) { console.log(`Error: ${error.message}`); console.log("D"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
